description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractHttpEndpoint' for HTTP-based Hono endpoints, providing utility methods for JSON extraction, response handling, event bus communication, and CORS configuration within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AbstractHttpEndpoint
classes.description: An abstract class providing common HTTP endpoint functionalities such as JSON payload extraction, response handling, event bus messaging, and CORS setup for Eclipse Hono HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: extractRequiredJson
methods.description: Checks Content-Type, parses JSON payload, and stores it in RoutingContext with error handling.

methods.name: extractRequiredJsonPayload
methods.description: Extracts JSON payload from RoutingContext assuming JSON content type.

methods.name: extractOptionalJsonPayload
methods.description: Extracts JSON payload if present; otherwise, sets empty JSON object.

methods.name: extractRequiredJsonArrayPayload
methods.description: Extracts JSON array payload with workaround for specific Vert.x bug.

methods.name: getDefaultResponseHandler
methods.description: Provides default HTTP response handler with customizable success filter and optional post-processing.

methods.name: sendAction
methods.description: Sends a message over Vert.x event bus and processes the response with a handler.

methods.name: getTenantParam
methods.description: Retrieves tenant ID from request parameters.

methods.name: getDeviceIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves device ID from request parameters.

methods.name: extractIfMatchVersionParam
methods.description: Extracts 'If-Match' header value and stores as resource version.

methods.name: createDefaultCorsHandler
methods.description: Creates CORS handler allowing POST, GET, PUT, DELETE for specified origin.

methods.name: createCorsHandler
methods.description: Creates CORS handler with specified allowed methods and origin.
